review_candidates.title: Desktop Engineer – Endpoint Management (Remote in Pittsburgh)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Desktop Engineer is responsible for the development, management, and optimization of end-user computing technologies across physical and virtual platforms. Job Duties And Responsibilities Support firm desktop imaging and deployment activities using tools such as Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM), Broadcom Ghost Solution Suite, or similar tools. Develop and maintain imaging standards for physical devices, including OS deployment, driver integration, and baseline application configuration
eligibility_evidence: Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote or hybrid work environment.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements Education: Bachelor's degree in an IT-related discipline, or equivalent training and experience, required. Experience Minimum of 5 years of experience supporting enterprise desktop and virtual desktop environments. Ability to access, use, and safeguard confidential and sensitive information while performing job responsibilities in work environments that support confidentiality, privacy, and information security requirements.
